name: fast-skuldelev
prompt: Edit the attached ship texture map for a Valheim mod. Produce ONLY a square flat diffuse/base-color texture map, no scene, no text or labels. CRITICAL: preserve every original UV island's exact silhouette, pixel position, scale and orientation; preserve background void positions and all seams, holes, rivet rows, framing and plank directions. Repaint interiors with coarse visible blocky pixel brush texture matching vanilla Valheim wooden longships: weathered dark tarred oak, muted warm chestnut timber, dull grey iron, restrained faded red and ochre paint. Matte surface, evenly lit, no glossy highlights or baked dramatic lighting. Simplify photographic fine noise to readable chunky grain. This map is fast-skuldelev.  Preserve all existing material divisions. Aim for a usable texture atlas, not a redesign of its layout.
